CardDescription.zh: 可以揉搓提升品质，也可以放在火上或者炉子里烤成黑麦饼。还可以与鱼肉、肉、血馅或浆果油脂糕搭配制作馅饼。
CardDescription.en: Can be knead to increase its quality and cooked in a fire or oven to make rye cakes. Can also be combined with Fish, Meat, Blood Filling or Berry Fat Cakes to create Pasties.
